name: Mohammed Nihal Reyasath
tagline: Electrical and Computer Engineering student | Data Science
bio: I’m an Electrical and Computer Engineering student at TKM College of Engineering and a BS student in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras. I build IoT systems, Android applications, and Python-based tools, with a strong interest in cybersecurity and data-driven problem solving.

projects.title: Assistive Wearable Alert System
projects.desc: An IoT wearable for disabled and elderly users that detects hand gestures and sound patterns to trigger alerts. Includes an Android caretaker app with real-time alerts and acknowledgment synced through Firebase.

projects.title: Emergency SOS System
projects.desc: A low-cost Arduino wearable that uses a pressure sensor and SIM800L GSM module to send SMS and voice-call alerts to preset contacts.

projects.title: Flight Reservation System
projects.desc: A Python and MySQL airline management system for passenger registration, flight booking, food ordering, and baggage management, with input validation and tiered fares.
